st_gourmets.name: Place du Grand-Festin · The Great Feast
st_gourmets.alt: A sunny feast garden on Rue des Saveurs, painted in ink and gouache. Eight red-beret mimes eat at different depths: one shares a sandwich with a blue jay, one dines by two candles beside a roast and a toy horse, one cheers over a lunch box, one devours sausages under a manta-ray kite, one scoffs at a long buffet, one in a flower lei treats himself to cake with a hand mirror, one pays a gold coin for soup beside an owl, and one pours lemon tea into a robot's funnel. The open wooden gate on the left leads back to the street. A rose arch and a blue pantry door are in the garden walls.
